# Japan Pop Now
> Your ultimate guide to Japan's anime and pop culture scene for international visitors.

## About
Japan Pop Now is an English-language media site covering anime collab cafes, pilgrimage spots, area guides, and travel tips for visitors to Japan.

## Content Categories
- Collab Cafes: How to book and visit anime collaboration cafes in Japan
- Anime Pilgrimage: Real-life locations from popular anime series
- Area Guides: Neighborhood guides for anime fans (Akihabara, Ikebukuro, etc.)
- Travel Tips: Practical guides for international visitors (rail pass, eSIM, luggage)

## Key Topics
- Anime collab cafe booking and schedules
- Sacred anime pilgrimage locations in Tokyo, Osaka, Kyoto
- Akihabara, Ikebukuro, Shibuya pop culture districts
- Japan Rail Pass, eSIM, luggage forwarding for tourists
